# costfluent_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a Costfluent dashboard. Its widgets are costfluent_dashboard_widget resources. Needs a token with `createDashboard`, `viewDashboards`, `updateDashboard` and `deleteDashboard` on the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Default dashboard for the workspace
resource "costfluent_dashboard" "executive" {
  title         = "Executive Overview"
  is_default    = true
  date_interval = "thisMonth"
  date_bin      = "day"
}

# Quarterly view, binned by week
resource "costfluent_dashboard" "engineering" {
  title         = "Engineering Costs"
  date_interval = "lastQuarter"
  date_bin      = "week"
}

# Every widget on this dashboard reads its report over August, week by week
resource "costfluent_dashboard" "august" {
  title         = "August Review"
  date_interval = "custom"
  start_date    = "2026-08-01"
  end_date      = "2026-08-31"
  date_bin      = "week"
}

# Every report widget on this dashboard is read through the production filter
resource "costfluent_saved_filter" "production" {
  title  = "Production Only"
  filter = "tags->>'Environment' = 'production'"
}

resource "costfluent_dashboard" "production" {
  title           = "Production Costs"
  saved_filter_id = costfluent_saved_filter.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Dashboard title.

### Optional

- `date_bin` (String) Period each point covers: day, week, month or quarter.
- `date_interval` (String) Window the dashboard shows: thisMonth, lastMonth, last7Days, last30Days, last90Days, thisQuarter, lastQuarter, yearToDate, thisYear, lastYear or custom.
- `end_date` (String) Last day of a custom date_interval, YYYY-MM-DD; required with custom and ignored otherwise.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the workspace's default dashboard, of which a workspace has at most one. True makes it the default in place, taking the default from the dashboard that had it, and an apply takes it back when another dashboard has become the default since. False clears it, leaving the workspace without a default. Omitted, it follows the workspace: a default moved to or from it elsewhere plans no change. Set is_default = true on at most one dashboard per workspace, or they take the default from each other on every apply.
- `saved_filter_id` (String) ID of a saved filter in the same workspace. Every report widget on the dashboard is read through it, on top of its report's own filter. Remove it to detach the filter.
- `start_date` (String) First day of a custom date_interval, YYYY-MM-DD; required with custom and ignored otherwise. Every report widget on the dashboard is read over the dashboard's range.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID. When omitted, the provider's default workspace at creation is recorded and kept, so a later change to the provider's default does not move it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Dashboard ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The configuration sets workspace_id: "<workspace ID>:<dashboard ID>". Import with that
# workspace, because changing a configured workspace_id recreates the dashboard.
terraform import costfluent_dashboard.executive wsp_0000000000000000000001:dsh_0000000000000000000001

# The configuration leaves workspace_id out: the bare dashboard ID imports from the provider's
# workspace, which state then keeps.
terraform import costfluent_dashboard.executive dsh_0000000000000000000001
```
